one_star_reviews.text:
As always, the airline staff were incompetent and unpleasant.
I had paid for the seat next to the emergency exit (because it has the most space). When I arrived, two flight attendants were waiting in those seats. One of them told me that my carry-on bag had to go in the overhead compartment (as is the case with this seat). When I started to lift it, she began to take it from me (I suppose out of excessive politeness), which almost caused the iPad I was holding in my other hand to fall. At that moment, her colleague intervened, saying I could keep the iPad with me, while the other one told me the iPad also had to go in the overhead compartment. The people waiting behind me to go to their seats were getting impatient, and in short, they ended up making me nervous. Finally, everything was properly arranged, and I sat down... surprise! You can't sit there (?) ...because your hand is shaking.

Indeed, I admit my hand was shaking... because of the absurdity of the situation. I didn't want to get into what seemed like it was going to be a pointless argument and create a bottleneck for the other passengers, so I opted to change my seat, for which, if I remember correctly, I had paid an extra €49 (and no one mentioned a possible refund), and sit in the place they indicated. Regarding my physical condition, I'm a former athlete and I still train (less intensely) for a couple of hours a day, including gym workouts and weightlifting. I think I still have more than enough strength and skill to open an emergency window on a Boeing 737. By the way, I also spent a few euros on the food on board. I could have bought a sandwich and been better off. The worst airplane food I've ever had.

This isn't the first time I've flown with Norwegian. In fact, one of the reasons I stopped flying with them was because of the negative and authoritarian attitude of their employees. This time it was almost out of necessity, but in the future I will make a greater effort to find an alternative.

one_star_reviews.text:
Had an appointment booked for an eye exam which according to their booking page would take 30 minutes, but that you would have a margin of about an hour to have time to get help choosing glasses. This visit took almost two and a half hours, mostly in waiting time for the staff who were barely available even for the booked eye exam.

Once I managed to get enough attention from the staff to complete the purchase, it took half an hour, had to pay a hefty advance and was booked to pick up the glasses. The evening before pick-up I get a message that they haven't received the glasses, with no indication of when they would receive them.

It's almost been a week since the booked pick-up, with no message and the store not answering phone calls.

I can sum it all up as Synoptik offers high prices, poor service and a huge waste of customers' time.
